Failures are NOT concentrated in low-confidence reviewer calls alone: 15/34 (44%) Alpha Match failures and 4/9 (44%) Polarity failures occur on HIGH reviewer-confidence rows, indicating a meaningful share of these are systematic semantic patterns (taxonomy-boundary confusion, stance-classifier calibration on hedged language) rather than pure annotation-boundary noise.

qqq_a001_independent_check.note: A001 shows 5/5 = 100% accuracy across the entire 200-row holdout set (any ticker) per item2_blind_holdout5_metrics.json -- zero A001 failures exist anywhere in this row-level authority, independently confirming the zero-overlap finding. This holdout set uses different run_ids than the six Gold v0.2 authoritative fresh runs and does not contain the QQQ run (f88c8956-...) analyzed in Step 5 -- no overlap is forced where none exists.

cross_checks.msft_a102_overlap_detail: holdout5-057 (MSFT, bear_researcher): reviewer expected A101, system predicted A102 -- the SAME A101/A102 taxonomy boundary Gold v0.2 explicitly grappled with (leading to the MSFT-A102-DIRECT/INDIRECT split at Gold freeze), but in the OPPOSITE direction from the Step-5 Gold v0.2 finding: here A102 is OVER-attributed (false positive) relative to the reviewer's A101 expectation, whereas the Step-5 MSFT-A102-DIRECT-INFERENCE-TRIGGER FAIL was an UNDER-detection (A102 not detected at all despite a PRESENT/STRONG trigger, on a different run: 43472ace-... vs this holdout row's run b71765a0-.../various). This is not the identical failure mode and is reported as a pattern-level (taxonomy-boundary) overlap only, not a same-row or same-mechanism match -- not forced beyond what the row-level evidence shows.

severity_criteria.HIGH: Cross-family confusion where a growth/cyclical-family Alpha (A101/A102/A103/A201/A301) is confused with a risk-family Alpha (A304/A501) or vice versa (could plausibly feed the wrong side of a growth-vs-valuation conflict evaluation), OR a genuinely multi-mechanism sentence where the wrong side was selected, OR (for polarity) a stance-classifier miscall on the same shadow evidence_stance.py mechanism already implicated in the Step-5 QQQ-A001 Formal Gold blocking defect.
severity_criteria.MEDIUM: Confusion between two Alphas within the same broad family/layer (e.g. A101/A102/A103 AI-theme siblings, A201/A301 industry-vs-company siblings), or an under-called supports_alpha read as mentions_alpha with no cross-family risk implication.
severity_criteria.LOW: False-positive attribution of a non-substantive, generic, technical, or purely background statement that the reviewer found immaterial; or a false-negative/missed detection on a row the reviewer's own note or formal adjudication already flags as low-confidence or genuinely ambiguous.

recommended_future_work.pattern: TAXONOMY_OVERLAP cross-family confusion (A201<->A304, A201<->A301, A103<->A304) and MACRO_VS_COMPANY_CONFUSION (A501<->A301)
recommended_future_work.rationale: These are the highest-severity Alpha Match failures: a cyclical/company-growth signal and a valuation-risk (or macro-risk) signal are being interchanged, which is precisely the kind of confusion that could feed the wrong side of a growth-vs-valuation (or macro) conflict evaluation. This does not reproduce the exact QQQ-A001 mechanism (that was a directional/topic-only mapping issue on a macro-cyclical Alpha), but is a related, recurring class of cross-family semantic mapping imprecision worth prioritizing given a materially similar failure class already caused a Formal Gold release blocker.

recommended_future_work.pattern: MENTION_VS_OPPOSITION_OVERCALL -- evidence_stance.py calling opposes_alpha on hedged/cautious/uncertain-direction language that reviewers read as a neutral mention
recommended_future_work.rationale: 5 of 9 polarity failures share this exact pattern on the SAME shadow evidence_stance.py classifier already flagged in Step 5 as under-calibrated for directional nuance (QQQ-A001's supporting trace). This independently corroborates that finding from a wholly separate evaluation set and ticker/run universe.

Same-family (AI-theme) neighboring-Alpha confusion; MEDIUM severity since both sides remain within the AI-growth thematic family, but recurring enough (4/34) and directly overlapping the same A101/A102 boundary Gold v0.2 itself found ambiguous enough to warrant a rule split.

recommended_future_work.pattern: MENTION_VS_SUPPORT under-calling (system says mentions_alpha, reviewer says supports_alpha)
recommended_future_work.rationale: Stance classifier appears conservative on declarative supportive claims embedded in longer/complex sentences.

recommended_future_work.pattern: GENERIC_BACKGROUND_EVIDENCE / AI_THEME_OVERGENERALIZATION false-positive attribution on non-substantive technical/trivia statements
recommended_future_work.rationale: Lowest-severity, highest-volume pattern: the largest share of Alpha Match failures (15/34) are false positives on content the reviewer found to have no material Alpha fit at all. Diagnostic-only impact expected (these tend to be low-scoring, loosely-matched claims unlikely to materially move activation), but worth a lower-priority mapping-precision pass given the volume.

recommended_future_work.pattern: NEGATION_OR_MODALITY_ERROR (epistemological/hedging statements read as asserting the mechanism)
recommended_future_work.rationale: Small, low-severity but clean pattern -- 'X is an assertion/estimate, not a fact' framing mistaken for a substantive claim.

cross_framework_disclosure: Gold v0.2 acceptance (Steps 4-5) evaluates ticker-level, evidence-conditional product behavior against six specific authoritative fresh runs. This Evidence Review (Step 6) evaluates row-level semantic Alpha-mapping and polarity correctness against a separate, older 200-row blind holdout sample spanning 8 tickers with entirely different run_ids. These are NOT the same evaluation and their percentages are NOT combined: 83% Alpha Match accuracy is not, and does not prove or disprove, Gold v0.2 acceptance; the QQQ Formal Gold release FAIL from Step 5 is not proven or explained in full by this 34-row failure set (no exact-row overlap was found for QQQ-A001, and only a pattern-level, opposite-direction overlap was found for MSFT-A102). Overlap is reported only where row-level evidence actually establishes it.
